input.story_prompt: STYLE AND IDENTITY BIBLE: One continuous vertical absurdist 3D internet-meme chase with crisp neon supermarket lighting and strong depth. The hero is always Zorp, the same tiny orange goblin with a round face, pointed ears, a cyan puffer jacket, purple propeller beanie, mirrored red sunglasses, and chunky gold chain. Zorp always rides the same small red shopping cart and hugs the same glowing green pickle jar. The pursuer is always the same seven-foot yellow rubber-chicken security guard with an orange beak and blue SECURITY sash. Preserve exact faces, body proportions, colors, clothing, cart, jar, aisle layout, lighting, and forward travel direction. The camera continuously dollies backward directly in front of Zorp at chest height, keeping Zorp large and centered while shelves create fast parallax. Never let Zorp leave the frame. Native synchronized stereo audio continues throughout: rattling cart wheels, squeaky chicken footsteps, refrigerator hum, action-matched impacts, and one continuous fast goofy bass rhythm that never restarts. Zorp has a high nasal mischievous voice; the guard has a deep rubbery squeak-voice. Spoken quoted lines must be exact, intelligible, and visibly lip-synced. No narrator, subtitles, captions, logos, cuts, fades, scene resets, time jumps, held poses, or empty frames.
segment_prompts: [0-2s] Already moving fast, Zorp pumps one foot against the tile and the red cart rockets toward the backward-tracking camera while the pickle jar pulses green; shelves streak behind him. [2-4s] The rubber-chicken guard lunges into view behind the cart, flapping both rubbery arms and squeaking with every running step. [4-6s] Zorp steers left then right through two swinging scanner gates as red scan beams chase across his jacket and the wheels chatter in rhythm. [6-8s] Without slowing, Zorp faces the camera, mouth clearly moving, and shouts exactly, "PICKLE PROTOCOL!" while one hand steers and the other holds the jar. [8-10s] The cart fishtails under a collapsing arch of cereal boxes; Zorp ducks, the guard bats boxes aside, and both continue charging forward through the final frame.

[0-2s] Continue from the supplied boundary frame: cereal boxes are still falling as Zorp straightens and accelerates, cart wheels spinning and the guard still close behind. [2-4s] Three dancing bananas slide into the aisle one after another; Zorp slaloms around each one while the camera keeps retreating and the jar flashes with every turn. [4-6s] The guard bounds over the first banana, slips sideways on the second, windmills both arms, and recovers without stopping. [6-8s] While running and pointing at Zorp, the guard's beak visibly opens and says exactly, "RETURN THE JAR!" over squeaky footsteps and the same bass rhythm. [8-10s] Zorp kicks the third banana backward; it spins beneath the guard as the cart surges onto a moving checkout conveyor, all bodies and props still moving at the boundary.

[0-2s] Continue from the supplied boundary frame with the cart rolling along the moving checkout conveyor while Zorp leans forward and the guard runs beside it. [2-4s] Scanner lights flash rapidly across Zorp, the jar, and the cart as grocery cans pop upward in a chain and land behind them on the beat. [4-6s] Zorp grabs a dangling receipt roll; it unspools into a long white ribbon that whips around the guard's legs while both keep advancing. [6-8s] Zorp looks toward the guard while steering, mouth visibly moving, and says exactly, "SCAN THIS, CHICKEN!" as he flicks the receipt ribbon. [8-10s] The ribbon slingshots the guard forward; the guard lands running behind the cart as Zorp launches off the end of the conveyor into the next aisle, continuing through the boundary.

[0-2s] Continue from the supplied boundary frame as the cart lands, suspension bouncing once, and immediately speeds down a freezer aisle with cold vapor streaming past. [2-4s] Zorp yanks open freezer doors one after another while moving; harmless clouds of blue frost burst behind the cart and briefly wrap around the pursuing guard. [4-6s] The guard punches through the vapor, shakes ice from its rubber head, and gains ground with huge squeaking strides while Zorp zigzags around rolling frozen pizzas. [6-8s] Still sprinting and pointing, the guard opens its beak clearly and says exactly, "YOU'RE BANNED FOREVER!" while Zorp reacts with a moving head turn but never slows. [8-10s] Zorp tips the glowing jar forward; a bright green brine trail appears behind the cart and the wheels flare green as they accelerate through the final frame.

[0-2s] Continue from the supplied boundary frame with green-lit wheels spinning faster and the cart surfing along its glowing brine trail while the guard skates after it. [2-4s] Zorp grabs two hanging pool noodles and paddles the air like oars, weaving around a tumbling pyramid of soda bottles as fizzy sprays arc behind him. [4-6s] The guard blocks one spray with a yellow wing, vaults over the wobbling bottles, and lands close enough to grab the cart handle while everything keeps moving forward. [6-8s] Zorp twists toward the camera, visibly speaks while pumping one noodle, and shouts exactly, "ACTIVATE BRINE DRIVE!" as the jar flashes intensely. [8-10s] A green pulse kicks the cart forward; the stretched guard snaps after it like rubber, feet skimming the floor, as the automatic exit doors rush closer without anyone stopping.

[0-2s] Continue from the supplied boundary frame: the green-powered cart races straight at the opening automatic doors while the stretched guard grips the handle and streams behind it. [2-4s] The doors open just in time; Zorp ducks under the frame, the propeller beanie spins wildly, and the guard compresses through with a loud rubber squeak. [4-6s] Outside under neon parking-lot lights, the cart splashes through a shallow puddle, throwing two bright water fans while the camera still tracks backward and keeps both characters visible. [6-8s] Zorp turns toward the guard while steering, mouth clearly moving, and declares exactly, "DELIVERY COMPLETE!" as the guard releases the handle and bounces onto a rolling floor mat. [8-10s] Zorp raises the glowing pickle jar overhead with one hand while the other steers; the cart and camera keep racing forward, the guard rolls alongside waving both arms, wheels and bass hit a final rapid flourish, and clear motion continues through the last frame.
